articles.title: Shell (LSE:SHEL) Cuts Ormen Lange Output 40% After Failure Extends Outage To 2027
articles.summary: Shell (LSE:SHEL) has cut output at Norway's Ormen Lange gas field by 40% after a subsea compressor failure. The outage is now expected to last until 2027, extending the period of reduced production. The disruption affects a key source of gas for Europe as the region prepares for the coming winter.
